description: This file defines data structures and a store class for managing instances of nodes within the application, including fetching, normalization, and event handling for node presence and connection status.

classes.name: InstancesStore
classes.description: An observable singleton class managing the list of instances, handling periodic refresh, presence events, and health checks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic refresh and event listening tasks if not in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing refresh and event listening tasks.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches current presence data from the control channel, handling errors and fallback.

methods.name: localFallbackInstance
methods.description: Creates a fallback InstanceInfo based on local system info.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push events and dispatches to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: decodeAndApplyPresenceData
methods.description: Decodes presence data and applies it to update instances.

methods.name: handlePresenceEventPayload
methods.description: Decodes and handles presence event payloads.

methods.name: normalizePresence
methods.description: Converts raw presence entries into normalized InstanceInfo objects.

methods.name: applyPresence
methods.description: Updates the store with new presence entries and notifies on new node connections.

methods.name: notifyOnNodeLogin
methods.description: Sends notifications for newly connected nodes.

methods.name: probeHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs a health check if necessary and updates the instances list accordingly.

methods.name: snippet
methods.description: Creates a string snippet from raw data for logging.
